languageData.AmorQueenXenotype.label: Amor Queen
languageData.AmorQueenXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Queen. The Queen incubates and lays Amor Brood Mother eggs and also produces the Tentacle Slime resource.
languageData.AmorQueenXenotype.descriptionShort: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Queen.
languageData.AmorBaronXenotype.label: Amor Baron
languageData.AmorBaronXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Baron. The Baron acts as a defender for the colony, and can also provide mobile storage for Amor Squirmer tentacles.
languageData.AmorBaronXenotype.descriptionShort: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Baron.
languageData.AmorBaronessXenotype.label: Amor Baroness
languageData.AmorBaronessXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Baroness. She carries Amor Squirmer tentacles and can transfer them to other Hosts.
languageData.AmorBaronessXenotype.descriptionShort: A human Host that carries Amor Squirmer tentacles for other Hosts.
